evidence.description:
Ever wondered what it really costs to start, buy, or run a business?

At Business Decoded, we break down the real economics behind businesses—from pizza shops and coffee shops to airlines, hospitals, banks, hotels, restaurants, gas stations, shopping malls, trucking companies, and more.

Our videos go beyond the headlines to explain startup costs, operating expenses, hidden costs, profit margins, business models, risks, mistakes, and the financial reality of owning a business.

Whether you're an entrepreneur, investor, business student, or simply curious about how businesses actually make money, you'll find clear, data-driven, and easy-to-understand business documentaries every week.

On this channel you'll learn about:

Business Economics
Startup Costs
Business Finance
Small Business
Entrepreneurship
Hidden Costs
Profit Margins
Business Models
Investments
Real Business Case Studies
Financial Education

Subscribe and discover the real cost behind every business.
